meta.source: Coded from the published QP and mark scheme (1MA1/1F, Wednesday 6 November 2024, P75157A). Derived metadata only — question numbers, marks, mark-scheme codes and skill tags. No exam question text transcribed.
meta.note: First Edexcel November series in the audit. Coded WITH mark_split, unlike the six June 2025 Edexcel papers, so it contributes to lib/exam/markEvidence.data.ts. Every (Total for Question N) line was recovered except q1–q5, q12 and q24, whose markers pdftotext dropped; all seven are single-mark items and the paper sums to the printed 80.

coding_notes: q7b (what type of angle is x) tagged angles_on_lines_and_circles, the documented handling for 'classify an angle by type' — measuring_lines_and_angles is about protractor use and is what q7a and q7c are.
q11a (complete a two-way table) tagged gathering_and_organising_data, following the AQA and Edexcel precedent for two-way tables.

q14b (total surface area of a cuboid) tagged areas_of_squares_and_rectangles: the documented taxonomy gap is real — spheres, cones and cylinders each have a surface-area node and cuboids do not — but the mark scheme rewards finding rectangle areas and adding them, which is inside that node's territory rather than outside the taxonomy.

q19a tagged expected_outcomes first and mutually_exclusive_events second: the answer is an expected count, but the first process mark is for making the six probabilities sum to 1. Both sit under Probability and Data so the topic column is unaffected either way.

q22a tagged estimating before compound_units, matching the established handling of 'estimate by rounding first' items (JUN23-F-P3 24a, JUN25-F-P1 14a, OCR-JUN25-F-P2 10). The first process mark is for the rounding, not for the speed formula.

q24 (what the gradient of a volume-time graph represents) tagged kinematic_graphs. A rate-time graph whose gradient is a rate is structurally a distance-time graph; precedent is the hand-authored AQA 2F Nov 2024 q15b bath graph.
q9d ('write 5:4 in the form n:1') tagged simplifying_ratio, following OCR-JUN25-F-P1 q19.
